Implement solve(xs: list[int]) -> int. Return the length of the longest run of consecutive elements that all share the same parity (all even, or all odd). A single element counts as a run of length 1.

Write your implementation and verify it before submitting.

args.code:
from solution import solve
cases = [
    ([1, 3, 5, 2, 4, 6, 8], 4),
    ([2, 4, 6], 3),
    ([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 1),
    ([7], 1),
    ([2, 2, 2, 2], 4),
    ([-1, -3, 2, 4, 6, -8, 10], 5),
    ([1, 3, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 11, 13], 6),
    ([0, 2, 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 12, 14, 16], 7),
    ([], 0),
]
ok = True
for xs, exp in cases:
    got = solve(xs)
    status = "OK" if got == exp else "FAIL"
    if got != exp:
        ok = False
    print(status, xs, "expected", exp, "got", got)
print("ALL PASS" if ok else "SOME FAILED")
